thread:
Elena: Quick idea - introduce a 'minimal snapshot' export API for investigations. Returns tokenized rows, zipped + encrypted with an ephemeral DEK wrapped by CMK. Default retention 14d, extendable via legal hold. Looking for feedback on RBAC & workflow.
Sam: Like that. Key Q: how do we handle PII fields? Tokenize by case-id so analysts can correlate but not see raw PII unless explicitly approved.
Tom: Agree re: deterministic tokens. For rehydration we should require a separate `unmask` workflow with 2 approvers and a legal ticket. KMS wrap + key-access logs needed.
Ana: Legal hold note - if Legal issues a hold we need a retention override to 365d with WORM flag and immutable storage. That needs an auditable justification.
Elena: Also thinking of two export modes: 1) "forwarded view" (no unseal, filtered fields) and 2) "sealed snapshot" (ephemeral unseal -> sealed artifact). Prefer forwarded where possible.
Sam: Can we auto-scrub headers and oauth tokens in the forwarder? If so many cases won't need sealed snapshots.
Tom: Implementation sketch: artifact service calls KMS:GenerateDataKey, encrypt artifact, store DEK wrapped by CMK with tags {requester,case,ttl}. Audit event emitted to audit-log.
Elena: Rough request payload I imagine:
```json
{
  "requester": "vuln-team@redwood",
  "dataset": "auth-events",
  "window": "2026-04-01T00:00:00Z/2026-04-01T12:00:00Z",
  "mode": "sealed_snapshot",
  "fields": ["ts","user_hash","ip_masked","path","status"],
  "purpose": "incident_investigation",
  "ticket": "INC-2026"
}
```
Ana: Legal: if an export contains PII we require a legal ticket and justification. Bot will attach a hold tag to the export record.
Legal-Bot: See policy: <https://legal.redwood/policies/exports|Data Export & Hold policy> - include `legal_hold:true` on the ticket for overrides.
sec-bot: Created ticket SIEM-3087 for the prototype + RBAC review, assigned to Tom and Elena. :white_check_mark:
Sam: Who owns the automation and runbook? Eng-infra should own the code, SecOps owns approver list and docs.
Tom: We should also add automated purge job (14d default) and a one-click quarantine for suspected data leaks.
Elena: Action items: 1) Eng-infra prototype sealed snapshot (Tom), 2) SecOps draft RBAC + approver matrix (Sam + Ana), 3) Legal to sign off on hold process (Ana). I'll follow up with a short RFC.
Ana: Also propose metrics: number of sealed snapshots, avg time-to-approve, number of rehydrations. Helps justify minimizing sealed usage.
Elena: Cool, I'll schedule a sync Wed 9am PT. Thanks everyone.
